task.title: Immediate task completion persistence in festina-implement
task.description: Reorder mark_task_complete to run immediately after verification passes, ensuring task completion is persisted before context can exhaust.
task.problem:
When implementing large plans, tasks get executed successfully but are not marked complete in plan.xml because context exhaustion occurs before the mark_task_complete substep runs. The current skill has mark_task_complete at the end of the task execution loop (after confirm_done_criteria), meaning large plans exhaust context before all marking steps complete.
Evidence: In plan 029, tasks 2-9 have identical timestamps suggesting bulk marking rather than incremental persistence.
This causes confusion about progress and potential re-implementation of already-completed tasks when sessions are resumed.
task.value: - Reliable progress tracking across sessions - No lost work from re-implementing already-completed tasks - Clear resumability for large plans - Trust that completed work is actually recorded
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given a large plan with multiple tasks And the festina-implement skill is executing When a task passes verification (run_verification step succeeds) Then mark_task_complete runs immediately after run_verification And the completed attribute is persisted to plan.xml before confirm_done_criteria
Given multiple tasks being implemented When each task completes Then each task shows its own completion timestamp And timestamps are not identical across tasks (no bulk marking)
